notes.title: Bokuhime PROJECT Perfect Soundtrack is now on sale!
notes.content:
Notice to ladies and gentlemen!

A soundtrack containing all the BGM of the [b]Bokuhime PROJECT[/b]
[b]Bokuhime PROJECT Perfect Soundtrack[/b] is now on sale!

The sales page is ↓↓ here ↓↓
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783400/PROJECT_Perfect_Soundtrack/]Bokuhime PROJECT Perfect Soundtrack[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41210302/726c72b6370b892e292ebf75e9ba6459271d59e8.jpg[/img]

If you listen to it, you will feel like a maiden's garden!
Please enjoy the Bokuhime world by hearing!


* Since serious spoilers are included, we recommend that you listen after clearing all of them.
